facts.business: TANFAC Industries Limited manufactures industrial chemicals including hydrofluoric acid, solar-grade diluted hydrofluoric acid, sulphuric acid, and refrigerants, and is the first and only producer of solar-grade DHF in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: 20,000 TPA HFC-32 refrigerant-gas facility with associated utilities and value-added fluorine products
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Targeted for commissioning by end of Q3 FY27

guidance_or_targets.statement: HFC-32 facility is targeted for commissioning by the end of Q3 FY27
Secured long-term refrigerant-gas supply arrangements aggregating approximately Rs 3,61,250 lakhs over five to seven years
Held solar-grade DHF orders of ~Rs 1,06,800 lakhs to be executed till FY29, covering close to 85% of annual capacity
Further agreement of ~Rs 6,100 lakhs per annum for an indefinite duration, covering close to 67.5% of the planned annual capacity

key_risks: Depreciation increased following recent capital expenditure
Delayed submission of XBRL Related Party Transaction by one day (compliance risk)
No set procedure in place for sustainable sourcing
Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) applicability and compliance
facts.related_party_note: Delayed submission of XBRL Related Party Transaction for the half year ended September 30, 2025 by one day; fine of Rs 5,000 imposed by BSE Limited. The Company submitted the XBRL within 24 hours after financial results.
